# ISummerVestingWalletV2
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/ISummerVestingWalletV2.sol)

**Title:**
ISummerVestingWalletV2

Interface for SummerVestingWalletV2, an improved vesting wallet with configurable parameters
Key Features:
- Configurable cliff end date (Unix timestamp)
- Configurable cliff amount
- Configurable time-based vesting after cliff (number of periods and total amount)
- Custom performance criteria with amounts and descriptions
- Recallable tokens (both time-based and performance-based)
- Support for delegation of unvested amounts


## Functions
### token

VIEW FUNCTIONS             ///

The token being vested


```solidity
function token() external view returns (address);
```

### vestingParams

Get vesting parameters


```solidity
function vestingParams() external view returns (VestingParams memory);
```

### performanceGoals

Get performance goal by index


```solidity
function performanceGoals(uint256 index) external view returns (PerformanceGoal memory);
```

### getPerformanceGoalsCount

Get number of performance goals


```solidity
function getPerformanceGoalsCount() external view returns (uint256);
```

### getAmountPerPeriod

Get amount per vesting period


```solidity

```

### addNewGoal

MUTATIVE FUNCTIONS           ///

Adds a new performance-based vesting goal


```solidity

```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`goalAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens for this goal|
|`description`|`string`|Description of the performance criteria|

```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`goalNumber`|`uint256`|The number of the goal to mark as reached (1-indexed)|


### recallUnvestedTokens

Recalls unvested tokens (both time-based and performance-based)

```

## Events
### NewGoalAdded
EVENTS                 ///

Emitted when a new goal is added


```solidity
event NewGoalAdded(uint256 indexed goalNumber, uint256 goalAmount, string description);
```

### GoalReached
Emitted when a goal is reached


```solidity
event GoalReached(uint256 indexed goalNumber);
```

### UnvestedTokensRecalled
Emitted when unvested tokens are recalled


```solidity

```

## Errors
### InvalidGoalNumber
ERRORS                 ///

Thrown when an invalid goal number is provided


```solidity
error InvalidGoalNumber();
```

### InvalidToken
Thrown when the token address is invalid


```solidity
error InvalidToken(address token);
```

### InvalidVestingParams
Thrown when vesting parameters are invalid


```solidity
error InvalidVestingParams();
```

### CliffNotEnded
Thrown when cliff has not ended yet


```solidity
error CliffNotEnded();
```

### CallerIsNotFactoryOwner
Thrown when caller is not the factory owner


```solidity
error CallerIsNotFactoryOwner(address caller);
```

### TokensAlreadyRecalled
Thrown when trying to recall tokens that have already been recalled


```solidity
error TokensAlreadyRecalled();
```

## Structs
### PerformanceGoal
STRUCTS                 ///

Struct representing a performance goal


```solidity
struct PerformanceGoal {
    uint256 amount;
    string description;
    bool reached;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens for this goal|
|`description`|`string`|A description of the performance criteria|
|`reached`|`bool`|Whether the goal has been reached|

### VestingParams
Struct for vesting parameters


```solidity
struct VestingParams {
    uint64 cliffEndTimestamp;
    uint256 cliffAmount;
    uint256 vestingPeriods;
    uint256 totalVestingAmount;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`cliffEndTimestamp`|`uint64`|Unix timestamp when cliff period ends|
|`cliffAmount`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens to vest at cliff|
|`vestingPeriods`|`uint256`|Number of vesting periods after cliff|
|`totalVestingAmount`|`uint256`|Total amount to vest over periods (excluding cliff)|
